text: Identify the two divisions of the Court of Appeal. [2]
Identify two types of alternative dispute resolution (ADR). [2]
Identify five sources of persuasive precedent. [5]
Describe three reasons why a judge might excuse or defer a person from serving on a jury. [6]
Assess the need for society to have both civil and criminal law. [10]

parts.text: Explain the literal and mischief rules of statutory interpretation.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Assess the extent to which the rules of statutory interpretation prevent judges from making law.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how the police should make a lawful arrest without a warrant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess the extent to which the law on arrest without a warrant strikes a fair balance between
the powers of the police and the rights of the individual.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how lay magistrates are selected.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess the extent to which the selection process ensures that the most suitable people
become lay magistrates.
